Enrich person.name: Brandon Oliver
Enrich person.title: Vice President
Enrich person.summary:
Brandon Oliver is a Vice President in Member and Provider Services at Centene, a leading healthcare enterprise committed to helping people live healthier lives. Centene focuses on government-sponsored healthcare programs and primarily serves under-insured and uninsured individuals.

In his current capacity, Oliver leads quality assurance and data & analytics for contact centers that handle 40M+ interactions annually. Initially recruited to Centene to align strategic priorities and talent, and enable value creation initiatives for contact center standardization and next generation technologies, he also provided leadership for workforce management, vendor management and learning & development in these contact centers.

Prior to Centene, he was a Senior Director at Conifer Health Solutions, a subsidiary of Tenet Healthcare Corporation, helping health systems and physician practices address their most pressing challenges with revenue cycle, population health and value-based care. At Conifer Health Solutions, Oliver provided direction and leadership in the development of compelling and competitive solutions, prepared business cases that summarized key elements of proposed transactions and generated forward looking financial statements for complex opportunities.

Oliver’s career has its foundation in client-facing roles with information technology services providers, fortified by experiences with data center migrations and infrastructure implementations. He joined Dell through its acquisition of Perot Systems, a company with healthcare specialty and characterized as a pioneer in the digitization and automation of medical records.

Oliver graduated magna cum laude from the University of Texas at Arlington.

I help organizations navigate complexity, improve performance, and deliver better experiences for the people they serve.

As an Enterprise Healthcare Executive with more than 20 years of leadership experience, I have led large-scale operations across Medicaid (Medi-Cal), Medicare, Marketplace, Commercial, Group, and Self-Funded lines of business. Throughout my career, I have been trusted to lead organizations through periods of significant change, aligning strategy, operations, culture, and performance to improve outcomes for members, employees, providers, and stakeholders. I am particularly passionate about building high-performing organizations that balance service excellence, operational discipline, financial stewardship, and workforce engagement.

My leadership experience includes:
• Enterprise Operations Leadership
• Customer, Consumer & Patient Experience
• Medicaid, Medicare & Marketplace Programs
• Claims, Enrollment & Payment Integrity
• Regulatory & Compliance Oversight
• Operational Excellence & Transformation
• Workforce Strategy & Culture Change
• Technology & AI-Enabled Operations
• Executive Governance & Strategic Planning

My leadership philosophy is simple:

Say the thing. Fix the thing. Do the work.

I believe organizations thrive when leaders create clarity, accountability, and environments where people can do their best work, especially during periods of rapid change and transformation.

Enrich person.name: Mike Penrod
Enrich person.title: Vice President Technology Integrations
Enrich person.summary:
I am a senior technology executive with more than 20 years of experience helping organizations navigate growth, transformation, and complexity through technology. My career spans healthcare, financial services, and wealth management, where I have led enterprise infrastructure, digital transformation, contact center modernization, AI enablement, service management, and M&A integration initiatives.

I currently serve as Vice President of Technology Integrations at Focus Financial Partners, a private equity-backed wealth management organization with more than $500 billion in assets under management and nearly 300 offices across North America, Europe, and Australia. In this role, I partner with business and technology leaders to integrate acquired firms into a standardized operating model, enabling scalable growth while preserving business continuity and client experience.

Prior to Focus, I served as Staff Vice President of Digital Technologies at Centene Corporation, a Fortune 25 healthcare enterprise. I led teams responsible for automation, contact center technologies, CRM platforms, document digitization, Site Reliability Engineering, and shared services. During my tenure, my teams delivered $4 million in annual labor savings through AI-enabled automation, generated more than $15 million in recurring operational savings through platform consolidation and modernization, and achieved $26.5 million in software licensing savings.

A consistent theme throughout my career has been leading organizations through periods of significant change. I have integrated teams and technologies following major acquisitions, modernized operating models, consolidated platforms, and aligned technology investments to business outcomes. Whether operating as a VP in large enterprises, a CIO-equivalent leader in smaller organizations, or a transformation executive in acquisition-driven environments, I am often called upon to bring clarity, stability, and execution to complex challenges.

Beyond my professional responsibilities, I serve on the Board of Directors for Hope Creates, a nonprofit dedicated to helping teens, young adults, and veterans maintain sobriety through engagement in the arts. I also serve as an Adjunct Professor at Saint Louis University, teaching Organizational Behavior and Leadership.

My leadership philosophy is simple: build strong teams, create clear direction, and align technology to measurable business value. Sustainable transformation happens when strategy, execution, culture, and people move forward together.
Enrich person.headline: Technology Executive | VP / CIO-Level Leader | Digital Transformation, M&A Integration, and Operational Excellence
